reports.category: Fake Return Scams: Secure Your Crypto Investments
reports.description: June 4th 2020: A Youtube channel that looked identical to the official SpaceX channel was playing what appeared to be a live video with Elon Musk. There was a constant QR code on the video feed. The QR code brought you away from Youtube and promised to double the coins you sent. Intriguing custom bitcoin address beginning with "1Musk". Red flag I noticed afterwards was that the channel didn't have a checkmark. The chat that seemed live never had comments long enough to have wrapped text, so it was a bot. I don't have the site the QR code sent me to but it was a bit sketchy.

I personally didnt fell for this scam, but if you check the activity, 3 people already fell for it and the scammer already made rounded 5k.
